verdict.rationale: The MI325X ships with a software ecosystem (ROCm, the HIP runtime, libraries and tools) that has APIs, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. However, the evidence shows only static documentation, recipes and an llms.txt file. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
